description: The data of a screen.stable event: a watched area stopped changing. The attachment is a PNG picture of the area when "Attach a picture to each event" is yes. This state is the new base of the area.

event.description: The watch event: change, stable, clipboard, bell, or resize.

area.description: The name of the area. "screen" when no area is set.

rect.description: The area in reference pixels (the screen size at the first connect).

changed_pct.description: The percent of the area pixels that changed.

changed_px.description: The number of pixels that changed.

bbox.description: The bounds of the pixels that are different from the state before the change, in reference pixels.

changing_ms.description: How long the area changed before it stopped.
